_comment: Open datasets planned for training the prototype's models. ml/download_open_data.py downloads a pinned version of each into data/<name>/ (git-ignored, not committed). Each is a proxy: none of them contains FDRs. 'used_by' names the script that reads it; 'planned_for' names a script that will read it once its own change lands.

find-it-again.licence: Not stated on the Kaggle page (research dataset); all rights reserved until the authors confirm terms. Cite the paper.
find-it-again.citation: B. Martinez Tornes et al., Receipt Dataset for Document Forgery Detection, ICDAR 2023
